title: Starlink Now Outnumbers Every Other Satellite
hook: One company owns the sky now.
source: Source: Jonathan McDowell's satellite catalog / KeepTrack.space tracking data, active satellites by year, 2019-2026. SpaceX launched Starlink's first batch of 60 satellites in May 2019; the constellation passed 10,000 active satellites in 2026. Figures approximate.
